integrity: The two-observation impossibility is proved analytically by reducing both performance ratios to strictly increasing functions of the same gain-to-loss ratio. The three-observation witness, equal-mean variance decomposition, denominator-convention robustness, and all-larger-sample padding family are checked with exact rational arithmetic in the standalone verifier.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns equally weighted finite differential-return samples, a common zero target/benchmark, positive mean, nonzero downside risk, and the lower-partial-second-moment Sortino convention. It is a ranking-possibility theorem rather than a claim about statistical adequacy of very short return histories.
title: Three return observations are the sharp Sharpe–Sortino ranking split
